### 1. Reading the Data

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
```

```{r}
# Convert DBF to XLSX

# From https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41796530/r-converting-dbf-files-to-excel-files-xls

library(rio)

files <- list.files(path = "2019-Cobriza,Peru", pattern = "\\.dbf", full.names = TRUE)

peru.df <- sub("\\.dbf$", ".xlsx", files)

mapply(convert, files, peru.df)

```

```{r}
# Filter and prep data
library(readxl)

cadia <- read_excel("ps.xlsx")

str(cadia)
head(cadia)
```

```{r}
# Selecting example data point

pts <- subset(cadia, cadia$velocity == -25)

start_date <- which(names(cadia) == "D_20160927")

example_pt <- pts[4, start_date:ncol(pts)]

example_pt
```

```{r}
# Recreating plot of Cumulative LOS displacement time-series

date_full <- names(cadia[start_date:ncol(cadia)])

dates <- as.Date(sub("D_", "", date_full), format = "%Y%m%d")

plot(dates, example_pt, xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', type = "p", pch = 19)
abline(h = 0)
haxis(2, at = seq(-60, 60, by = 10), las=2)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

disp <- as.numeric(example_pt[1, ])

df_plot <- data.frame(date = dates, disp_mm = disp)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(date, disp_mm)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ylim(-60, 60)
```
